smell_validity.evidence: Foldable is reduced to raw keys while folder, color and point-2d each re-derive the same state machine (measurement choreography, 0/px/auto height, completion, expanded/cpl classes) in four drifting shapes: split tiers, null guards, rack hook. The removed model helpers make the healthy ownership boundary self-evident, exposing a consequential fault.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Any tweak to expansion semantics must be replicated across five sites in three components and both tiers; the copies already diverge, so missing one silently changes behavior of visually similar components. Consolidation restores a lasting ownership boundary, though the gain is subsystem-wide rather than architecture-level.

development_plausibility.evidence: The re-implementations reuse real utilities (disableTransitionTemporarily, forceReflow, emitters), follow house idioms (bound handlers, trailing-underscore privates), sit inside existing popup/inline branches, and drift structurally like real anemic-model decay from a dumb-model cleanup plus per-component fixes. No task-shaped scaffolding or artificial regularity is visible.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Problem, scope and drift match the code; the behavior freeze names the exact silent-failure modes (initial-render classes, empty-folder completion, popup mirroring without inline height, measure flow) plus API and test commands, foreclosing partial consolidation and wrong unification; one tier-placement aside is loose but not misleading.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three purposes each need a different code-supported decision: presentation sync (element targeting plus popup/inline gating), measurement choreography (set-flag/reflow/measure/restore ordering), and completion lifecycle (transitionend propertyName filter versus rack add/remove events). Sites also differ in tier placement and nullable elements.

localization_burden.evidence: Consumers span components' controllers and views, and classification requires combining configuration-selected registration (pickerLayout picks mirror-versus-binder wiring) with emitter and DOM callback dispatch chains. Plausible-looking exclusions exist: the popup connectValues mirror and import/export raw-key access.

repair_coordination.evidence: Consolidation couples gating, dual element targets, tier placement and completion timing: a uniform binder behind the nullable picker guard leaves popup expanded/cpl classes unapplied once ColorView's local sync is deleted, so inline calls succeed while the popup stage breaks; dropping the rack hook fails empty folders.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: No helper remains to reconnect since the model was emptied, so the most direct repair is unavailable. Extracting the shared height ternary covers only a fragment of three sites, and a single binder call pattern fully repairs roughly one site; the rest need gating, dual-target, rack-hook and tier decisions.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Specific wrong edits pass ordinary toggles but fail in special states: dropping rack add/remove completion leaves stale shouldFixHeight/expandedHeight and missing cpl after empty-folder or mid-animation changes; layout-blind class binding loses popup-mode classes; skipping initial sync breaks first render. No test evidence supplied to establish unchecked paths.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
